# Requirements Readiness Checklist: F1 — Ingest approved learning documents

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency and measurability of F1's requirements before implementation proceeds.
**Created**: 2026-10-02.
**Feature**: [F1 specification](../spec.md).
**Focus**: Approval/data boundaries and ingestion/lifecycle contracts, including temporary local storage and recovery.
**Depth**: Standard.
**Actor / timing**: Human feature reviewer, before implementation and separately authorized live validation.

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist F1` from the existing spec, plan, contracts and tasks. This is a requirements-quality checklist, not an application test plan or approval record.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines that the written requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality; it does not mean implementation, corpus approval, acquisition approval, or live verification is complete. All items were initially unchecked; the evidence audit below records current review status.
**Authority**: [docs/constitution.md](../../../../docs/constitution.md) remains the sole active constitution; the Spec Kit constitution scaffold is inactive.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are required source approval evidence, decision ownership, classification, access and redistribution boundaries documented separately from implementation authorization? [Completeness, Spec §Approved inputs and governance gates, §Decisions, FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the input and result requirements defined for ingestion, inspection, scoped clearing and session closure, including required fields and unknown-field rejection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007/008/010; Contract §Operations, §Serialized schemas and semantic validation]
- [x] CHK003 Are source identity, revision, location, text and effective embedding/chunking configuration requirements complete enough to establish provenance for every inspected chunk? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/004, AC-001]
- [x] CHK004 Are the Stage 1 compatibility guarantees and exclusion of retrieval, generation, memory, agents, tools and publication explicit throughout F1's scope? [Completeness, Spec §Scope and scenarios, FR-013/014]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are local-only data flow and permitted storage endpoint requirements explicit, including redirects, proxies, network boundaries and prohibition of runtime downloads? [Security, Spec §FR-011; Plan §Technical context; Contract §Entry point and permission boundary]

- [x] CHK026 Are untrusted document handling, intentional inspection disclosure and minimized telemetry/access/retention requirements specified independently of persistent user memory? [Privacy, Spec §FR-012, §Memory, index, and traces]

## Evidence audit — 2026-10-02

The user explicitly requested a complete evidence audit and authorized checking only
supported items. The initial assisted audit was not human signoff. The user subsequently stated
“I've approved the requirements.” and requested all readiness gaps addressed. This
records requirements approval and assisted remediation, not corpus/acquisition
approval, runtime verification, or a waiver of any unmet criterion.
The generation-time statement that all new items were unchecked describes the initial
state. Current result after remediation: **32 Satisfied / checked; 0 Missing / unchecked;
0 Decision required; 0 Not applicable**. Every existing criterion is preserved verbatim.
All 32 criteria apply to F1's written requirements; none requires completed F1 code
merely to judge the quality of the requirement. Separate execution decisions follow.

### Remediation approval and current status

- Approval evidence: user on 2026-10-02, “address all readiness issues/gaps. I've approved the requirements.” The reviewer’s existing requirements.md approval annotation “by EDM” is preserved exactly.
- Requirements statuses: readiness.md 32/32 checked; requirements.md 18/18 checked. CHK012/031/032 criteria were not changed or waived; the linked source documents supply the missing evidence.
- Changed design records: spec, plan, tasks, research, CLI contract, serialization schema, data model and quickstart. The worker/teardown budgets are design requirements, not measured results.
- Remaining execution boundaries: T001 preparation/current dispositions; real T002 source approval and T003 acquisition/build approval; F0 fresh full local Docker gate; all F1 implementation/red-green/live acceptance work. Those are not missing written-requirement criteria and do not add F1–F7 requirements to F0.
- Current verification: schema, document-link, preserved-criteria, task-marker and changed-path checks are recorded by this remediation; no application tests/builds, model runs, index operations or external actions are claimed from these edits.
